text:
tess_sales: Quick help — VendorCo POC can't finish onboarding. Okta SCIM calls return 403 and SSO fails for new users.
omar_se: Do we have the Okta event? 403 = token scope or tenant mismatch usually.
tess_sales: Okta log: `403 Forbidden - missing permission: scim.write` They claim they used the API key from the Dedicated pool page.
leo_infra: That's the runtime inference key — doesn't grant control-plane SCIM scopes. I'll create a short-lived control-plane token with scim:write and send via secure link.
deploy-bot: token issued: tenant=vendorco-poc-7 scopes=[scim:read,scim:write] expires=2026-03-22T01:12:00Z (link shared internally)
omar_se: Also confirm they're hitting the right host. If they use shared host they must include header `X-Redwood-Tenant: vendorco-poc-7`. If they hit the tenant control plane they need VPC access.
tess_sales: Sent both notes. They retried and now Okta shows `SAML assertion missing group attribute` for the failing users.
anya_sec: Our SAML consumer accepts `groups` or the groups OID; if IdP uses `memberOf` we can add it to fallbacks. Tell them we can update tenant mapping temporarily.
leo_infra: Added fallback for vendorco-poc-7 and enabled scim.groups=true so group pushes are allowed. deploy-bot: config update: tenant=vendorco-poc-7 saml.attributeFallbacks updated; scim.groupsEnabled=true
tess_sales: VendorCo confirms users provisioned and SSO works now. Demo back on. Thanks team! :tada:
